title: Leopard edit (beat-synced)

scenes.headline: Takes prey up to 10x its weight

caption:
Seven cuts, one cat.

Leopards are solitary, mostly nocturnal hunters and often carry their kill into a nearby tree.

Source: Animal Diversity Web.  Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
notes: Fan-edit demo: 2 s beat cuts of wild CC leopards (India, Uganda, Nepal, Tanzania, South Africa) + one fact card. Real format is high-risk with third-party footage (unoriginal/copyright); only OK with our own or CC-licensed media plus added context, as here. Music would also need a licence.
